text:
```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Generate release notes
      id: generate_release_notes
      run: npx release-please --repo-url=https://github.com/material-components/material-web --path=packages/mdc-button --release-type=minor --manifest=packages/mdc-button/package.json

    - name: Create release
      id: create_release
      uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        release-type: minor
        path: packages/mdc-button
        target-branch: main
        manifest-file: packages/mdc-button/package.json
        repo-url: https://github.com/material-components/material-web
        github-api-url: https://api.github.com
        github-graphql-url: https://api.github.com/graphql
        fork: false
        include-component-in-tag: true
        proxy-server: ''
        skip-github-release: false
        skip-github-pull-request: false
        skip-labeling: false
        release-notes: ${{ steps.generate_release_notes.outputs.release_notes }}

    - name: Upload release assets
      uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
      with:
        repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        file: packages/mdc-button/dist/material-components-web.min.css
        tag: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.tag_name }}
        asset_name: material-components-web.min.css
        overwrite: true
        promote: true
        draft: false
        prerelease: false
        make_latest: true
        release_name: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.release_name }}
        body: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.body }}
        target_commit: ${{ github.sha }}
        repo_name: material-components/material-web
        release_id: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.release_id }}
```
